recovery.description: Bootstrap the Cluster by recovering backups from a Barman Cloud ObjectStore instead of with initdb.

objectStore.description: The barmancloud.cnpg.io ObjectStore holding the backups to recover; empty bootstraps with initdb.

serverName.description: The name of the cluster whose backups objectStore holds.

targetTime.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp with its zone to stop the replay at; empty replays to the end of the archive.
